ACCOUNTING_DOMAINS.BYTES_PERSISTED: Output publication persistence separately observed; neither return count nor hash proves durability
ACCOUNTING_DOMAINS.LOGICAL_RECORD_BYTES: Canonical encoded record length including LF, at most8192 each and at most3emitcalls
ACCOUNTING_DOMAINS.WRITE_BYTES_SUBMITTED: Sum of os.write buffer lengths, not progress; a remaining suffix can be submitted multiple times
ACCOUNTING_DOMAINS.WRITE_BYTES_TRANSFERRED: Sum positive returned n; bounded by logical record length per emit

BOUND_ASSURANCE: Conservative bound using source admission ceiling, not exact attainable record size or observed runtime requirement; does not prove an exact deficit or infeasibility.
PYTHON_API_MODEL: For N-byte record, each positive short write advances offset by integer at least1. A final zero/error stops that emit. Therefore maximum explicit Python os.write argument-length sum is N+(N-1)+...+1=N(N+1)/2.
SYSCALL_RETRY_LIMITATION: Python/libc/kernel EINTR/internal syscall retries are not separately counted by this API-level model; if governing semantics count those, exact mediation/semantics remain unbound.
